managePayments.heading: Payments
managePayments.state.not_connected.title: Not set up yet
managePayments.state.not_connected.body: About 10 minutes only. You will need your bank details and ID.
managePayments.state.requirements.title: Stripe needs your details
managePayments.state.requirements.body: Card payments will not work while Stripe does not have your business and bank details.
managePayments.state.pending.title: Connected — Stripe is checking your details
managePayments.state.pending.body: You do not need to do anything. Stripe is reviewing what you sent, and this page will update when they are done.
managePayments.state.ready.title: Connected
managePayments.state.ready.body: Your Stripe account is connected and can now take payments.
managePayments.state.restricted.title: Card payments are paused
managePayments.state.restricted.body: Stripe paused card payments on your account until something is fixed.
managePayments.state.unsupported.title: Card payments are not available on this account
managePayments.state.unsupported.body: Stripe cannot enable card payments here. Get in touch with us and we will fix it together.
managePayments.keyMismatch.title: The Stripe keys do not match
managePayments.keyMismatch.body: This site’s server uses the {server, select, live {live} other {test}} Stripe key, but the browser was built with the {browser, select, live {live} other {test}} key. Card payments will fail at the very moment a customer pays, so setting up Stripe is blocked until the two match.
managePayments.keyMismatch.fix: Both keys must be set for the same environment, and the site rebuilt afterwards — the publishable key is baked in at build time, and the secret key is read on every request.
managePayments.permission.title: Only the truck’s owner can set up payments
managePayments.permission.body: The person who owns the bank account that will receive the money connects Stripe, so it must be set up from their own logged-in account. There is no problem with this truck or with HatchGrab.
managePayments.config.keyMissingTitle: Card payments are not configured yet
managePayments.config.fetchTitle: We cannot check this truck’s Stripe account
managePayments.config.keyMissing: Not set: {name} — the embedded components cannot load.
managePayments.online.heading: Online payments
managePayments.online.body: Customers pay by card when they order. The money goes straight to your own Stripe account — we never hold it.
managePayments.online.feeLine: Stripe charges {fee} per payment on standard {region}. Other cards can cost more. HatchGrab’s own fee on online orders depends on your plan — see Billing.
managePayments.online.testMode: Test mode. Real payments cannot be taken yet.
managePayments.trialNote: This will not start your subscription and you will not be charged today. This is how your customers pay you — your plan is separate.
managePayments.admin.title: Viewing as platform admin
managePayments.admin.body: This truck’s online payments are not set up yet. Only the owner can start it, from their own logged-in account — there is nothing to press here.
managePayments.toast.addDetails: Now add your details for Stripe
managePayments.onboarding.restricted: Stripe takes over from here — you will sign in to Stripe and update the details it needs.
managePayments.onboarding.firstRun: Stripe takes over from here — you will sign in to Stripe, then give your business and bank details.
managePayments.details.title: Your Stripe details
managePayments.details.body: Change the bank account you are paid into, or update your business details and documents.
managePayments.walkUp.heading: Walk-in payments
managePayments.walkUp.body: How you take money at the truck. HatchGrab has no platform fee on walk-in orders, whichever you choose.
managePayments.walkUp.ownTerminalHelp: Zettle, Square, or whatever you already use. Nothing needs setting up — only your provider’s own fees are paid.
managePayments.walkUp.hatchgrabHelp: Uses the same Stripe connection as your online payments — a card reader, or contactless straight on your phone or tablet.
managePayments.walkUp.hatchgrabFees: {fee} per payment on {region}, plus {surcharge} for contactless taken on a phone or tablet. Other cards can cost more.
manageCharges.heading: Tax, tips and fees
manageCharges.rate.label: Sales tax rate
manageCharges.rate.hint: The rate you charge on every order. Customers see it added at checkout, on the receipt and on tickets.
manageCharges.rate.regionDefault: Leave blank to charge {label} at a rate of {rate}%, the rate on prepared food in {region}.
manageCharges.included.label: Already included in your prices: {label}
manageCharges.included.hint: {label} is already included in your prices. This rate only says how much of each price is {label}, on receipts and tickets — nothing is added at checkout.
manageCharges.included.default: Leave blank to use {rate}%, the {label} rate on hot take-out food in {country}.
manageCharges.tips.label: Tips
manageCharges.tips.hint: Customers paying online by card can tip. It all goes to you.
manageCharges.fee.label: Online service fee
manageCharges.fee.hint: Only added to online orders. Never on orders paid at the truck or on walk-in orders. It is yours.
manageCharges.fee.example: Customers see it before they pay, as one line: “{label} {amount}”.
manageCharges.fee.hatchgrab: HatchGrab adds a service fee of {fee} to your customers’ online orders. You are not the one paying it and you cannot change it.
takingPayment.heading: Taking payment
takingPayment.intro: How your team records the money for each order.
takingPayment.paidStepHelp: Adds a Confirm button when you add an order yourself, so you can place it now and take payment later. Turn this on if you take phone orders or advance orders.
takingPayment.paidStepNote: This only affects orders you added. It does not affect online orders.

weeklyPost.setup.intro: Upload the blank version of the weekly schedule graphic you already make — the same design, but with your own text boxes removed. HatchGrab fills in the week from your schedule.

weeklyPost.setup.canvaStep1: Open your usual weekly schedule design.
weeklyPost.setup.canvaStep2: Delete the text boxes with the dates, places and times — leave the background and headings you want to keep.
weeklyPost.setup.uploadHint: PNG or JPG, up to 10MB, at least {px}px on the short side.
weeklyPost.setup.phoneTip: Better on a computer or iPad — the boxes are small to drag on a phone.
weeklyPost.setup.pictureNote: Your picture with no date or place. We are the ones who add those.
weeklyPost.post.title: Your weekly post
weeklyPost.post.privateHint: They appear as “Private event” with the date and time — never the place.
weeklyPost.post.noteHint: Appears in the caption, and in the note box if you placed one.
weeklyPost.post.noOrderLink: No ordering link yet — set your truck’s web address in Settings.

manageBilling.card.title: Billing and payments
manageBilling.card.earlyAccess: While still in early access, we set up and adjust the plans manually.
manageBilling.plan.included: Includes online orders up to {amount} a month.
manageBilling.plan.ended: Your plan ({plan}) ended on {date}. You are now on {now}.

manageBilling.noCharge: 🔒 You will not be charged anything while you are on trial, until {date}. Billing only starts when you choose a plan and enter your payment details. Until then, there is nothing to cancel and nothing to pay.

manageTeam.privacy: Your personal details are private and never shown to customers. They are used for account management and billing verification.

manageTeam.inviteEmail.ignore: If you were not expecting this invitation, you can ignore this email.
manageWhatsApp.preview.title: Try before connecting
manageWhatsApp.preview.intro: Type a question as a customer would, and see exactly what answer they would receive. Nothing is sent to anyone.
manageWhatsApp.preview.noReplyWhy: That message looks like spam, a booking request or something unrelated, so the auto-reply will not answer.
manageWhatsApp.preview.footnote: Replies are AI-generated and vary slightly each time, and occasionally can be wrong.
manageWhatsApp.preview.failed: Cannot make a preview right now.
manageWhatsApp.preview.unreachable: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
manageWhatsApp.setup.popupHint: Can’t see the Facebook window? It may have been blocked. Allow pop-ups for hatchgrab.com, then press Start again.
manageWhatsApp.notice.sdkUnavailable: WhatsApp setup is not available in this environment.
manageWhatsApp.notice.sdkBlocked: Meta’s login script cannot load. The usual cause is an ad blocker or tracking protection.
manageWhatsApp.notice.setupFailed: The setup did not finish. Nothing was changed.
manageWhatsApp.notice.metaError: Meta reported a problem during setup. Nothing was changed. Try again, and contact us if it keeps happening.
manageWhatsApp.notice.closed: The setup was closed before it finished. Nothing was changed — press Set up to try again.
manageWhatsApp.notice.disconnectedUnreac: WhatsApp is now disconnected. We cannot reach Meta to remove the access. Please remove HatchGrab in WhatsApp Business → Settings → Account → Business Platform.
manageWhatsApp.notice.disconnected: WhatsApp is now disconnected. Auto-replies have stopped.
manageWhatsApp.card.title: Auto-replies
manageWhatsApp.card.description: Automatically answer customers’ questions on your social media, using your menu and schedule.
manageWhatsApp.card.popupInstruction: A Facebook window will open to connect your WhatsApp Business account. If nothing appears, allow pop-ups for hatchgrab.com in your browser, then press Set up again.
manageWhatsApp.card.switchedOff: WhatsApp auto-replies are off for your truck.
manageWhatsApp.card.expiring: Your WhatsApp connection needs renewing soon. Press Reconnect to keep auto-replies going.
manageWhatsApp.card.instagram: Auto-replies to Instagram direct messages. An Instagram professional account will be needed.
manageWhatsApp.card.messenger: Auto-replies to Facebook Messenger. A Facebook Page will be needed.
manageWhatsApp.blocked.title: Your replies are not being delivered
manageWhatsApp.blocked.body: WhatsApp refuses to send your automatic replies because of a billing problem on your WhatsApp Business account. Customers can still message you and you will still see everything they send — but they are not getting a reply.
manageWhatsApp.blocked.fix: You pay WhatsApp directly for these messages, so it is fixed in WhatsApp Manager. <link>Check your payment method</link>
manageWhatsApp.limit.heading: Auto-replies
manageWhatsApp.limit.label: Limit per month
manageWhatsApp.limit.usage: Used: {used, number} of {limit, number} · resets on {date}
manageWhatsApp.limit.perCustomer: Up to {n} replies per customer within 24 hours, then one message saying you will reply yourself.
manageWhatsApp.limit.emailAt: Replies stop when your limit is reached. We will email you at 80% and 100%.
manageWhatsApp.billing.heading: Billing
manageWhatsApp.billing.summary: Meta, not HatchGrab, charges your WhatsApp account for replies. From {from}, the first {free, number} a month are free. Correct as of {checked}; see <link>Meta’s pricing</link> for changes.
manageWhatsApp.billing.chargesTitle: Meta charges for WhatsApp replies, not HatchGrab.
manageWhatsApp.billing.chargesBody: Meta charges your WhatsApp Business account for each reply HatchGrab sends for you. From {from}, Meta gives {free, number} free replies a month per number; after that, each reply is charged at Meta’s rate. Replies you send yourself from the WhatsApp Business app are not charged. Meta sets these prices and may change them. <link>See Meta’s pricing</link>
manageWhatsApp.billing.addPaymentInManag: Add a payment method in WhatsApp Manager
manageWhatsApp.billing.aboveMissing: Your limit is above Meta’s {free, number} free replies. Without a payment method, Meta will stop all replies once those are used up.
manageWhatsApp.billing.aboveGeneral: Your limit is above Meta’s {free, number} free replies. Replies beyond that need a payment method on your WhatsApp account; without one, Meta stops all replies once the free ones are used up.
manageWhatsApp.disconnect.title: Disconnect WhatsApp?
manageWhatsApp.disconnect.body: Auto-replies stop immediately and HatchGrab loses access to your WhatsApp account. Your number still works in the WhatsApp Business app. To remove HatchGrab completely, also open WhatsApp Business → Settings → Account → Business Platform.
manageWhatsApp.signup.partial: We linked your WhatsApp Business account but could not finish the connection. Nothing is wrong on your side — please contact us and we will finish it.
manageWhatsApp.signup.noNumber: Your WhatsApp Business account is linked, but no phone number came back. Press Reconnect and finish the number step.
manageWhatsApp.signup.needsRegistering: Your account is linked, but we first need to register this number before replies can start. Please contact support — your setup is saved, do not run it again.
manageWhatsApp.signup.registerRefused: Your account is linked but Meta refused to register the number. Your setup is saved — please contact support instead of running it again.
manageWhatsApp.signup.deliveryRefused: Your account is linked but Meta refused to turn on message delivery. Your setup is saved — please contact support instead of running it again.
manageWhatsApp.signup.numberTaken: That WhatsApp number is already connected to another HatchGrab account. One number can answer for only one truck. Contact support and we will move it.
manageWhatsApp.signup.saveIncomplete: Almost there — we could not finish saving. Your setup is saved, please contact support instead of running it again.
manageWhatsApp.signup.connected: WhatsApp is now connected. Auto-replies will start answering messages to this number.
customDomain.card.title: Add your schedule to your website
customDomain.card.create: We will create a page at <addr>{address}</addr> that shows your schedule.
customDomain.card.justLive: {address} is working now. Have a look at it, then tell us below whether it is right.
customDomain.waiting.title: We are waiting for {address}
customDomain.waiting.bodySince: You set this up on {date}. A new web address usually works within a few minutes, and occasionally takes up to 24 hours to reach everyone — you do not need to do anything while that happens. If someone else is adding the line for you, it is good to check that they did it.
customDomain.waiting.body: A new web address usually works within a few minutes, and occasionally takes up to 24 hours to reach everyone — you do not need to do anything while that happens. If someone else is adding the line for you, it is good to check that they did it.
customDomain.ready.title: {address} is live now
customDomain.ready.body: Have a look at it, then tell us in your settings whether it is right.
customDomain.confirm.heading: Have a look, then tell us whether it is right
customDomain.confirm.checkTimes: Check that the dates and times are right.
customDomain.confirm.problemLine: Tell us what you are seeing and we will look at it.
customDomain.confirmed.heading: Thanks — we have noted that.
customDomain.confirmed.body: You have nothing else to do.
customDomain.turnOff.heading: Turn off your own web address?
customDomain.turnOff.carriesOn: This carries on as before, and it is where your QR code takes people:
customDomain.turnOff.reAdd: If you will set it up again later, leave the line you added at your web address company. If not, ask them to remove it.
customDomain.turnOff.failed: We cannot turn that off right now. Nothing changed — your address still works. Try again shortly.
customDomain.address.intro: Your schedule will get its own web address.
customDomain.address.question: What is your web address?
customDomain.address.hint: The one people already use to find you.
customDomain.address.noChange: Your website will not change — you just add a link to the new address.
customDomain.address.notSetUp: We have not set this up yet.
customDomain.address.restricted: Whoever looks after your web address must allow us to set up the padlock — the small lock customers see beside it. Until they add us, it will not appear, so we stopped for now so you do not wait with nothing happening. Ask them to add us, then try again.
customDomain.address.blocked: Your web address currently blocks the padlock completely. Whoever looks after it must allow it before this works. Ask them to change that, then try again.
customDomain.address.elsewhere: Something already answers on that address. Send the message on the next screen to whoever looks after it — they will know what to do.
customDomain.address.provider: {provider} looks after your web address. We will show you where to go.
customDomain.address.provisionFailed: We cannot set up that address.
customDomain.address.couldNotBeSetUp: That address cannot be set up.
customDomain.apex.empty: Type the address you want to use.
customDomain.apex.not_a_domain: That does not look like a web address.
customDomain.apex.unparseable: We cannot read that as a web address. Check the spelling and try again.
customDomain.apex.apex: {host} is your website’s whole address. If you point that at us, your website will be replaced by this page. Put a word in front of it instead — for example, events.{host}.
customDomain.apex.too_deep: That address has too many parts. Something like events.{domain} is best.
customDomain.record.addSomewhere: Add this where your web address is looked after, and save.
customDomain.record.hintWord: Just this word, not the whole address.
customDomain.record.timing: It usually works within an hour, but it can take longer. You do not need to keep this page open.
customDomain.record.someoneElse: Someone else looks after your web address?
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.open: Open your web address, then “DNS” and “Records”.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.add: Select “Add record”, then choose “CNAME” as the “Type”.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.name: Put the first value below in “Name”.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.value: Put the second value below in “Target”.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.proxy: Set “Proxy status” to “DNS only” — the cloud beside it must be grey, not orange.
customDomain.providers.cloudflare.caveat: If the cloud stays orange, the padlock will never appear, and nothing will say why.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.open: Open your “Domain Portfolio” and choose your web address.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.add: Select “Add New Record”, then choose “CNAME” in the “Type” menu.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.name: Put the first value below in “Name”.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.value: Put the second value below in “Value”.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.save: Leave “TTL” as it is and select “Save”.
customDomain.providers.godaddy.caveat: If you added more than one at the same time, the button says “Save All Records”.
customDomain.providers.123reg.signIn: Sign in to your “123 Reg Control Panel”.
customDomain.providers.123reg.manage: Beside “Domains”, select “Manage All”, then choose your web address.
customDomain.providers.123reg.name: Put the first value below in “Name”.
customDomain.providers.123reg.value: Put the second value below in “Value”, and put a full stop at the end of it.
customDomain.providers.123reg.caveat: 123 Reg needs a full stop at the end of the second value, otherwise it will not work.
customDomain.providers.wix.open: Open “Domains”, then click the “Domain Actions” icon beside your web address.
customDomain.providers.wix.add: In the “CNAME (Aliases)” section, click “+ Add Record”, then click “Got it”.
customDomain.providers.wix.name: Put the first value below in “Host Name”.
customDomain.providers.wix.value: Put the second value below in “Value”.
customDomain.providers.wix.save: Click “Save”, then click “Save Changes” in the pop-up.
customDomain.providers.wix.caveat: If your web address only points at Wix and is not held there, Wix cannot change this — whoever holds it must do it.
customDomain.instructionsEmail.subject: One record to add for {truckName}’s schedule page
customDomain.instructionsEmail.introAt: We are putting {truckName}’s live schedule on {address}, and it needs one record added to our domain at {provider}.
customDomain.instructionsEmail.introHold: We are putting {truckName}’s live schedule on {address}, and it needs one record added to our domain, with whoever holds our domain.
customDomain.instructionsEmail.wholeChan: That is the whole change — nothing else on the website is affected, and the rest of our domain keeps working as before. It usually works within an hour.
customDomain.instructionsEmail.pointsAt: The page it points at shows where we are trading next, and it updates itself.
customDomain.instructionsEmail.replyTo: Reply to {email} if you have a question.
customDomain.liveEmail.subject: {address} is working now
customDomain.liveEmail.body: Your schedule is now showing at your own address. Have a look at it and check it is right: open {address}, make sure the events are yours and the dates are right.
customDomain.liveEmail.confirm: Once you have, open your settings on HatchGrab and tell us it is right. Nothing depends on that — it is just so we know a person has seen it.
deleteAccount.scheduled: This account is scheduled to be deleted
deleteAccount.requested: Requested on {requested}. It is set to be deleted on {due}.
deleteAccount.orderingStopped: Online ordering has stopped. Your dashboard can still be read until that date.
deleteAccount.cannotCancelPending: You cannot cancel this on your own. To stop it, email {email} as soon as possible.
deleteAccount.title: Delete your account
deleteAccount.body: Permanently close this HatchGrab account and stop taking online orders.
deleteAccount.stopsImmediately: Online ordering stops immediately — not after 30 days. Customers will no longer be able to order from you the moment you confirm.
deleteAccount.upcoming: You have {count, plural, one {# upcoming order(s)} other {# upcoming order(s)}}. These still need to be fulfilled.
deleteAccount.allTrucks: All trucks on this account are included ({count}): {names}.
deleteAccount.deletedAfter: Your account will be deleted after 30 days. Your dashboard can still be read during that time.
deleteAccount.cannotCancel: You cannot cancel this on your own. To stop it, you must email <link>{email}</link>.
deleteAccount.whatHeading: What will be deleted, and what will be kept
deleteAccount.whatPersonal: Your and your team’s personal details will be deleted, and the logins will be removed.
deleteAccount.whatCustomers: Your customers’ names, emails and phone numbers will be deleted from your orders.
deleteAccount.whatAccounting: Anonymous accounting records will be kept for six years, as UK law requires. See our privacy policy.
deleteAccount.copyFirst: Want to get a copy of your data first? There is no download in the app. You have the right to a copy — email {email} before you confirm, and we will send it to you.
deleteAccount.typeAria: Type {name} to confirm deleting the account
deleteAccount.requestedToast: Account deletion requested. Check your email.
copyButton.announceFailed: Cannot copy: {thing}. Select the text and copy it yourself.
copyButton.announceFailedValue: Cannot copy the value. Select the text and copy it yourself.
eventPost.error.imageTooBig: Size of that image: {size}MB. The limit is 10MB.
eventPost.setup.stranded: These place pictures use the standard positions and are a different shape, so they will not be used until you replace them: {places}.
eventPost.setup.firstTitle: Set up your post for a single event
eventPost.setup.firstBody: Upload the picture you use for a single event — your artwork with no date, place or time. HatchGrab will add those for each event.
eventPost.setup.fileRule: PNG or JPG, up to 10MB, at least {px}px on the short side.
eventPost.setup.phoneWarning: Better on a computer or iPad — the boxes are small to drag on a phone.
eventPost.setup.addPlaceDesignLink: + Add a design for a place
eventPost.setup.standardDesignName: Design of the post for a single event
eventPost.setup.pictureNote: Your picture with no date or place. We are the ones who add those.
eventPost.setup.removeConfirm: Remove this place’s ({name}) picture and text positions? Events there will use your Standard design.
eventPost.setup.noEvents: No events yet — add one and the preview will use it.
eventPost.setup.pickerTitle: Add a design for a place
eventPost.setup.pickerAllDone: Every place already has a design.
eventPost.modal.title: Post for this event
eventPost.modal.standardNotPlace: Standard’s picture and text positions — not this place’s ({place}).
